ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65% of visible pixels are high-intensity white/light-grey and 35% are low-intensity black/dark-grey, primarily concentrated at the central midline.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous black pigmentation field extending from the peduncle attachment to the mid-lobe. Distal regions consist of high-intensity white fields heavily intersected by low-intensity, high-contrast dark linear streaks and irregular mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel-measured interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary along the trailing edge with frequent high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-15 pixel) peaks and valleys, particularly prominent on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature observed along the trailing edges of both lobes from the median notch vertex to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, circular clusters of yellowish-white pixels (approximately 10-30 pixels in diameter) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multidirectional, dark-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) that break the high-intensity white pigmentation across the ventral surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear predatory rake marks across the fluke surface; concentrated biological colonization (barnacles) on both lateral fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellow-toned pixel cluster (staining) present on the medial white region of the right lobe.
